string-array.name: legal_terms_sections
string-array.item: 1. About these terms\nThese terms apply to AI Finder: Where Did I Put It?, provided under the Techascent name (“we”, “us”). By using the app, you agree to these terms. For questions or support, contact bdtechascent@gmail.com.

2. What the app does\nAI Finder helps you record belongings, organize storage places, and find saved items using their last confirmed location and source photo. It is not a GPS tracker, live object locator, insurance valuation service, or guarantee that an item is still in a saved place.

3. Accounts and eligibility\nProvide accurate account information, protect your sign-in credentials, and use only accounts you are authorized to access. You must be legally able to agree to these terms or have permission from a parent or guardian where required. The app is not directed to children under 13 or below the applicable minimum age in their country.

4. Your content and responsibilities\nYou retain your rights to photos, notes, item details, and other content you submit. You give us permission to process, store, and transmit that content only as needed to provide and protect the service, including processing through our service providers. Submit only content you have permission to use. Do not upload unlawful content, violate others’ privacy or intellectual property, abuse the service, bypass access or credit controls, or interfere with other accounts.

5. AI suggestions and review\nPhoto analysis sends the submitted image to Google’s Gemini service through Vertex AI. AI can miss or misidentify objects and produce inaccurate labels, categories, confidence values, or positions. Review and correct suggestions before saving. Keep your inventory updated when belongings move. Do not rely on AI Finder for emergencies, safety-critical decisions, or proof of ownership.

6. Scan credits and welcome offers\nEach successful photo analysis uses one scan credit, even if you do not save the results. Retaking a photo before analysis, manually creating places or items, searching saved inventory, and scanning QR place labels do not use scan credits. Welcome credits depend on account eligibility and the applicable offer; they are not granted again on every sign-in or reinstall. Your available balance is shown in the app.

7. Purchases and refunds\nWhere available, you can purchase scan packs through your app store. The store displays the applicable price, currency, taxes, and purchase terms before confirmation. Scan packs are consumable credits, not recurring subscriptions. Credits are for use in the app and are not cash or transferable between accounts. Purchases and refunds are subject to store rules and applicable consumer law. If purchased credits do not appear, contact bdtechascent@gmail.com with the transaction reference, not payment-card details. Nothing in these terms removes mandatory refund or consumer rights.

8. Connectivity, exports, and availability\nSign-in, AI analysis, cloud writes, refresh, and purchases require connectivity. Offline access is limited to content already cached on the device; cloud changes are not automatically reflected everywhere. You are responsible for checking that important content has saved and for keeping independent copies where needed. Export recipients can access the information you share. Features may change or be temporarily unavailable; material changes affecting paid credits will be handled in accordance with applicable law.

9. Privacy and deletion\nOur Privacy Policy explains data handling. You can edit or delete individual items and remove source photos using the available controls. Sign-out or uninstalling the app does not delete your cloud account. To request account and associated data deletion, email bdtechascent@gmail.com from the account’s email address where possible. We may verify ownership and retain limited records where legally required or necessary to prevent fraud.

10. Suspension and ending use\nYou may stop using the app at any time. We may restrict access when reasonably necessary to address misuse, fraud, security risks, or legal requirements. Where practicable and lawful, we will provide notice and a way to contact us about the restriction. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.

11. Limitations and legal rights\nWe use reasonable care in providing the service but cannot promise uninterrupted access, perfect AI accuracy, or recovery of lost belongings or data. To the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for losses caused by inaccurate user records, unreviewed AI suggestions, or events beyond our reasonable control. Nothing excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limits your statutory rights. Applicable mandatory laws and consumer protections continue to apply.

12. Updates and contact\nWe may update these terms as features or legal requirements change. We will update the effective date and provide additional notice where required. For support, purchase issues, privacy requests, or questions about these terms, email bdtechascent@gmail.com.

string-array.name: legal_privacy_sections
string-array.item: 1. Who we are\nThis policy explains how AI Finder: Where Did I Put It?, provided under the Techascent name, handles information. Contact bdtechascent@gmail.com for privacy questions or requests.

2. Account and sign-in information\nFirebase Authentication manages sign-in. We receive the account identifier and available profile information, such as name, email address, and profile photo, from your sign-in provider. We do not receive your Google or Apple password. We also record the latest sign-in platform, provider, and device name or model.

3. Inventory and photos\nWe process the places and items you save, including names, nested place relationships, categories, notes, aliases, creation and confirmation dates, photo references, and available AI confidence values and object positions. Saved photos are uploaded to Firebase Storage. Place names are storage descriptions you enter, not GPS tracking. Photos can contain personal details beyond the objects you intend to record; avoid submitting sensitive documents, passwords, payment details, or people without permission.

4. AI photo processing\nWhen you request analysis, the submitted photo is transmitted to Google’s Gemini service through Vertex AI, even if you later choose not to save the results. Google returns object suggestions for your review. Our analysis request contains the photo and recognition instructions, not your inventory search queries. Provider processing and retention depend on the applicable Google Cloud terms and service configuration; we do not promise immediate deletion of AI requests or make an unconditional claim about model-training use.

5. Credits, purchases, and technical data\nWe process scan balances, welcome-offer eligibility, credit grants and usage, and purchase records such as transaction identifier, product, store, date, and crediting status. RevenueCat receives an app user identifier linked to your account to manage purchases. The app stores handle payment details; we do not receive your full payment-card information. Our providers may also process IP addresses, device and app information, request details, and operational or security logs needed to deliver their services.

6. Why we process information\nWe use information to authenticate users, store and retrieve inventory, analyze submitted photos, manage credits and purchases, generate labels and exports, provide support, diagnose failures, prevent abuse, and meet legal obligations. Where applicable, our legal bases are performance of the service you request, legitimate interests such as service security, compliance with law, or consent when required. Search over cached inventory and QR photo decoding happen on-device without an additional AI request.

7. Service providers and disclosures
We use Google Firebase for authentication, database, storage, and backend functions; Google Cloud Vertex AI for photo analysis; RevenueCat for purchases; and the applicable app store and sign-in provider. We share information with them as needed to operate the service. We do not sell your personal information. We may disclose information when legally required or reasonably necessary to address fraud, protect people or the service, or defend legal rights.

Provider privacy information:
Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy
Firebase: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
Google Cloud: https://cloud.google.com/terms/cloud-privacy-notice
RevenueCat: https://www.revenuecat.com/privacy/
Apple: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/

8. Permissions, local storage, and sharing\nCamera access is used to photograph belongings and scan labels. You can revoke permission in device settings. Inventory and photos are cached on your device for previously loaded content to remain accessible offline. Temporary sharing files may also be stored locally. CSV and PDF exports contain cached inventory metadata, not photo files. Recipients control copies you share. QR labels contain a place identifier and may display the place path; anyone who sees a label can read its printed text. In-app scanning opens only a place available in the signed-in account.

9. Retention and deletion\nWe retain account information, inventory, and photos while needed to provide the service, unless deleted or subject to a deletion request. Purchase, credit, security, and support records may be retained as necessary for legal obligations, fraud prevention, or disputes. Deleted data may temporarily remain in provider backups or logs according to their retention processes. Removing a source photo affects linked items but does not delete their names and placements. Other devices may retain cached photos until their local app data is cleared. We cannot erase files already shared with others. Signing out or uninstalling is not account deletion.

10. Your choices and requests\nYou can edit or delete items, remove source photos, export inventory metadata, and manage camera permission. To request access, correction, or deletion of your account and associated data, email bdtechascent@gmail.com, preferably from your account’s email address. We may verify ownership and will explain any applicable retention exceptions. Depending on your location, you may also have rights to portability, restriction, objection, withdrawal of consent where applicable, or a complaint to your data-protection authority.

11. Security and international processing\nWe use encrypted network connections and account-based controls to help protect information. No system is completely secure. Providers may process information outside your country under their applicable terms and legally required safeguards.

12. Children and policy updates\nThe app is not directed to children under 13 or below the applicable minimum age in their country. If you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us so we can investigate. We may update this policy as the app or our practices change, update its effective date, and give additional notice where required. Contact: bdtechascent@gmail.com.
